fields.description: When a billable item becomes a Sales Invoice line, for every service type - Lab, Imaging, Procedure, Service and Medication alike. on_request bills the moment an order is created; on_start when it is started; on_release when the result is released or the service completed; on_visit_close when the case is completed. on_release is the behaviour that predates this setting. Cancelling an order always removes its invoice line while the invoice is still a Draft; once the invoice is submitted, cancellation is refused and referred to the cashier.
fields.label: Billing Trigger

fields.description: When a prescribed medication becomes a Sales Invoice line. Overrides Billing Trigger for medication only; Lab, Imaging, Procedure and Service continue to follow Billing Trigger. on_request (at prescribe). on_release (at dispense, else at visit close). on_visit_close bills everything when the case is completed. on_start is not offered: a prescription has no start of its own, and the only moment it could map to - a partial dispense - is indistinguishable from on_release in practice. Once a medication has been billed its quantity is locked; to correct a dose, cancel the medication and prescribe it again.
fields.label: Medication Billing Trigger

fields.description: When on, medication prescribed on a visit is treated as covered by the Treatment boarding rate whenever the pet is on an active Treatment boarding stay: the billable row is created and priced, marked Included, and never becomes an invoice line - the same treatment boarding-ordered medication already gets. When off, visit medication is billed normally whatever the pet's boarding status. Affects only medication prescribed on a Vet Visit; boarding-ordered medication is unaffected either way.
fields.label: Include Visit Medication In Boarding Rate

fields.description: When on, any active Doctor may OPEN a colleague's Vet Visit, Lab, Imaging, PetCareService or Pet Procedure record for reading. Writing, closing, dispensing, invoicing and case ownership stay restricted exactly as before, and the page roles (Visits / Visits Read / Visits Update) still decide whether the user reaches the record at all. Applies only to practitioner_type = Doctor, on a practitioner that is not disabled, whose User is enabled. Service Providers and Coordinators are unaffected.
fields.label: Open Clinical Read For Doctors

fields.description: The default template each send surface offers. This is the only place a default lives: SEND_SURFACES (pet_app/notifications/send_targets.py) says which surfaces exist, this table says what each one sends. A surface with no row here, a blank row, and a row with Enabled off all mean the same thing - that surface's picker opens with nothing selected. There is no code-side fallback, so deleting a row cannot resurrect an older default.
fields.label: Send Defaults
